title: Hook
text: Did you know that every star, planet, and galaxy you can see in the night sky makes up just under five percent of the cosmos?
nxt: Everything humanity has ever studied, from the smallest atom to the most colossal galaxy, accounts for only about five percent.

title: A Sliver of Starlight
text: Here is an even stranger twist. Even inside that five percent, the stars we love to photograph are only a sliver.
nxt: When astronomers add up all the starlight in the cosmos, they find that stars hold well under one percent of the total.

title: One Hundred Pieces
text: Imagine the universe as a puzzle of one hundred pieces. Only five of them are made of the ordinary matter that builds planets, stars, and you.
nxt: The other ninety-five pieces are invisible. Scientists call them dark matter and dark energy.

title: Dark Matter
text: Dark matter accounts for roughly twenty-seven percent of the entire universe, dwarfing everything we know by more than five times.
nxt: It is not made of protons, neutrons, or electrons.

title: Dark Matter

nxt: It emits no light, absorbs no light, and reflects no light, yet scientists suspect its gravity is the glue that holds galaxies together.

title: Dark Energy
text: Dark energy makes up roughly sixty-eight percent.
nxt: In the 1990s, astronomers studying distant exploding stars discovered that the expansion of our universe is not slowing down. It is speeding up.

title: Your Living Room
text: If a cloud of dark matter passed through your living room right now, you would not see it, hear it, or feel it touch your skin.
nxt: Leading hypotheses suggest it may consist of undiscovered subatomic particles that barely interact with normal matter at all, but no one knows for sure.

title: The Cosmic Pie
text: Normal matter makes up roughly five percent. Dark matter claims about twenty-seven percent. And dark energy commands an overwhelming sixty-eight percent.
nxt: Together, dark matter and dark energy make up roughly ninety-five to ninety-six percent of the total cosmic pie. It is a humbling picture of our reality.

title: Bright Foam
text: When you step outside tonight and look up at the night sky, remember that the stars and galaxies are not the main show.
nxt: They are merely tiny specks of bright foam floating on top of a vast, unseen ocean.
